'''Automaps''' were tracking devices that allowed an individual to locate their exact position on a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] surfaces. Many commercial models were available, from hand-held units to ones designed to be installed in [[Droid/Legends|droids]], such as [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub's]] [["AutoTracker" Droid GPS Module]].<ref name="CFTD" /> SoroSuub also produced the [["Tracker" GPS Module]] hand-held unit.<ref name="OS">{{WEGCite|story=Operation: Shadowstrike (adventure)|book=Instant Adventures}}</ref>

The automap was linked to an [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] or [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. Data broadcast to the user included location, local weather conditions, and navigational hazards.<ref name="CFTD" />
